verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware chip, so a sandbox-versus-production data environment is a category error for this product type. The Xcode simulator mention (docs-3) only describes faster builds on the chip. Simulators are host-platform software, not a sandbox capability the chip ships, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
